corrections.text: The article quotes Michael Buschbeck as saying "Dynamic Debugging lets me work in optimized builds while still being able to deoptimize and inspect code when needed." The source (Microsoft's C++ Team Blog) actually quotes him saying: "Dynamic Debugging is a game changer for C++ development. It lets me work in the optimized builds I actually need for large game codebases, while still being able to deoptimize and inspect code and runtime state when it matters. It removes a longstanding tradeoff between realistic runtime performance and a productive debugging experience." The published sentence condenses and reworks this three-sentence statement rather than reproducing it verbatim.

The article quotes Bryce Hutchings as saying "It's seamless—you forget how much it's helping." The source actually quotes him saying "It's so seamless you forget how much it's helping." The published quote omits the word "so" and alters the punctuation.
